I posted a reply in #coastal-team, in your thread, saying I can't give you the ticket number from here. I didn't include it.

The only match I found is a note from Moss dated 2 Nov, addressed to Ruth Calloway. You aren't in the channel it came from, so I didn't repeat what it says. Asking Moss or Ruth directly is the quickest way to get the answer.
